verdict.rationale: Ashby ships Ashby Assistant, a first-party chat-based agent. Users ask questions in plain language and take actions across Ashby, such as analyzing pipelines, updating candidates and drafting emails. It is also available in Slack, and it respects existing permissions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Assistant, detailed documentation of the full set of supported natural-language actions and their limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: A chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language and take action across Ashby from a single interface. Analyze pipelines, update candidates, draft emails, and more, with custom agents for repeated workflows.
Today, we're releasing Ashby Assistant, a chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language
Ask questions, submit feedback, call custom agents, and more directly from Slack.
Your existing Ashby permissions apply, so it can only read and act on information you can already access.
